hook.en: In a class of 35, 20 students play badminton and 18 play football. That's 38 — more than the class! The overlap (students who play both) is the key, and Venn diagrams make it easy to see.
hook.bm: Dalam kelas seramai 35 orang, 20 pelajar bermain badminton dan 18 bermain bola sepak. Jumlahnya 38 — lebih daripada kelas! Pertindihan (pelajar yang bermain kedua-duanya) ialah kuncinya, dan gambar rajah Venn memudahkannya.

bigIdeas.en: Intersection A ∩ B: elements in both A and B.
bigIdeas.bm: Persilangan A ∩ B: unsur dalam A dan B.

bigIdeas.en: Union A ∪ B: elements in A or B or both.
bigIdeas.bm: Kesatuan A ∪ B: unsur dalam A atau B atau kedua-duanya.

bigIdeas.en: Complement A′: elements in the universal set ξ but not in A.
bigIdeas.bm: Pelengkap A′: unsur dalam set semesta ξ tetapi bukan dalam A.

bigIdeas.en: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B) avoids double counting.
bigIdeas.bm: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B) mengelak pengiraan berganda.

definition.en: The set of all elements under consideration.
Common elements of two or more sets.
definition.bm: Unsur sepunya dua atau lebih set.

definition.en: All elements of the sets combined.
Elements of ξ not in the set.
definition.bm: Unsur ξ yang bukan dalam set itu.

definition.en: Sets with no common elements: A ∩ B = ∅.
definition.bm: Set tanpa unsur sepunya: A ∩ B = ∅.

question.en: In a class of 35, 20 play badminton (B), 18 play football (F) and 6 play neither. How many play both?
question.bm: Dalam kelas seramai 35, 20 bermain badminton (B), 18 bermain bola sepak (F) dan 6 tidak bermain kedua-duanya. Berapa orang bermain kedua-duanya?

steps.en: Students who play at least one sport: n(B ∪ F) = 35 − 6 = 29.
steps.bm: Pelajar yang bermain sekurang-kurangnya satu sukan: n(B ∪ F) = 35 − 6 = 29.

explanation.en: A ∪ B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} — list each element once.
explanation.bm: A ∪ B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} — senaraikan setiap unsur sekali.

prompt.en: n(A) = 10, n(B) = 8, n(A ∩ B) = 3. Find n(A ∪ B).
prompt.bm: n(A) = 10, n(B) = 8, n(A ∩ B) = 3. Cari n(A ∪ B).

prompt.en: n(ξ) = 30 and n(A ∪ B) = 15. Find n((A ∪ B)′).
prompt.bm: n(ξ) = 30 dan n(A ∪ B) = 15. Cari n((A ∪ B)′).

prompt.en: In a class of 35, 20 play badminton, 18 play football and 6 play neither. How many play both?
prompt.bm: Dalam kelas 35 orang, 20 bermain badminton, 18 bermain bola sepak dan 6 tidak bermain kedua-duanya. Berapa orang bermain kedua-duanya?

prompt.en: Using the class above (9 play both), how many play ONLY badminton?
prompt.bm: Menggunakan kelas di atas (9 bermain kedua-duanya), berapa orang bermain badminton SAHAJA?

prompt.en: If A ∩ B = ∅, sets A and B are…
prompt.bm: Jika A ∩ B = ∅, set A dan B ialah…

explanation.en: They have no elements in common — their circles don't overlap.
explanation.bm: Tiada unsur sepunya — bulatannya tidak bertindih.

prompt.en: If A ⊂ B, then A ∩ B = …
prompt.bm: Jika A ⊂ B, maka A ∩ B = …

explanation.en: All of A is inside B, so the common part is A itself. Also A ∪ B = B.
explanation.bm: Seluruh A di dalam B, jadi bahagian sepunya ialah A. Juga A ∪ B = B.

options.en: Part of C outside both A and B
options.bm: Bahagian C di luar A dan B

options.en: Part of A and B inside C
options.bm: Bahagian A dan B di dalam C

options.en: The centre where all three overlap

explanation.en: (A ∪ B)′ = outside A and B; intersect with C = the part of C not in A or B.
explanation.bm: (A ∪ B)′ = di luar A dan B; bersilang dengan C = bahagian C yang bukan dalam A atau B.

prompt.en: The symbol ∪ represents the ______ of sets.

explanation.en: ∩ is intersection; ∪ is union (think 'U' for union).
